title: Plan S: AI E-commerce Operations
summary: Product selection → copy & images → detail page → pricing & promos → automated support → data review
scenario: Best for marketplace sellers and store teams — using AI to speed up selection, listing, copy and support.

steps.title: Product selection analysis
steps.detail: Feed store data (sales, competition, review pain points) to the AI: find categories with demand gaps and manageable competition, and mine 'opportunities in negative reviews'.
steps.tips: Having the AI dig improvement points out of competitor bad reviews beats gut-feel selection.

steps.title: Copy and images
steps.detail: Generate titles (with search terms), selling points and SKU descriptions; AI images for hero and scene shots (use Ideogram/Flux for accurate text, then polish product shots).
steps.tips: Put the user's search term at the front of the title; write selling points as 'pain → solution → proof'.

steps.title: Detail page
steps.detail: Structure: hero selling point → scene shots → specs → comparison → after-sales; AI writes copy and page structure, you verify the specs.
steps.tips: Specs and promises must be true; run a human pass for advertising-law red lines (absolute claims, exaggerated benefits).

steps.title: Pricing and promos
steps.detail: Have the AI suggest pricing from competitor bands and cost, and design promo combos (discounts, gifts, bundle-to-hit); generate event copy for big sales.
steps.tips: Price for the profit-vs-conversion balance, not gross margin alone; keep promos simple.

steps.title: Automated support
steps.detail: Build an AI agent to auto-answer high-frequency queries (logistics / returns / sizing), escalating sensitive ones; reuse the Plan P knowledge-base method.
steps.tips: Response speed drives conversion and reviews; automate the top-frequency questions first.

steps.title: Data review
steps.detail: Review conversion, refund rate, reviews and traffic sources; have the AI find problems and opportunities, then iterate selection and copy.
steps.tips: Feed negative reviews and refund reasons to the AI for root causes — more useful than watching revenue alone.

pitfalls.title: Unclear metric definitions
pitfalls.detail: Align definitions first (GMV vs gross profit vs net, period); the AI computing against the wrong metric misleads decisions.

pitfalls.title: Chaotic pricing
pitfalls.detail: Promo vs daily price conflicts cause disputes; manage the price system in a table and re-check.

pitfalls.title: Advertising-law red lines
pitfalls.detail: Absolute claims, exaggerated benefits and unfair comparisons get fined; human compliance review before publishing.

pitfalls.title: Image copyright
pitfalls.detail: Mixed AI/stock assets trip licensing; confirm commercial rights and use your own product shots.
